search_window.basis: Previous verified Food Line heartbeat completion to this execution; search-engine recency indicates index freshness, not original publication timestamp.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary Food Line recall; production nationwide collector remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster of the only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store in a community
Canceled/suspended emergency food distribution due to storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
Abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or material food-access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "only grocery store" OR "sole grocery store" closed fire November 2 2026
"last grocery store" OR "only supermarket" closed burned November 2026
"full-service grocery" closed fire power outage November 2026
"food bank" closed outage flooding fire November 2 2026
SNAP benefits outage delay EBT November 2 2026 state agency
WIC benefits interruption suspended November 2 2026 state health department
coverage_notes.observation: No new independently verified, source-dated and qualifying U.S. food-access disruption surfaced in the 12 bounded searches since the previous verified completion. Returned material was predominantly historical, routine service calendars or SNAP issuance information; no new official immediate benefits interruption was substantiated.

excluded_examples.reason: Historical relief and resource information rather than new distribution cancellation in the bounded window.

excluded_examples.publisher: Center on Budget and Policy Priorities
excluded_examples.reason: Prior month general policy/participation tracker, not a newly announced benefit interruption in the hourly window.
Routine issuance schedule and general troubleshooting; not a verified outage.
Previously identified Provo closure; excluded as duplicate per prior verified heartbeat.

duplicate_screen.method: Fetched prior watch-ledger heartbeat from GitHub branch and used its completion as cutoff.

coverage_notes.limitations: Targeted indexed web searches cannot prove absence of unindexed or delayed hyperlocal/official notices. Some search results are older despite 1-2 day recency filters; source publication date is used for screening. The watch remains supplementary.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approvals, publication, schedule changes, task disabling, or production collector changes.
